visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a prepared dish of spaghetti with clams and broccoli on a dark blue plate. A blurry kitchen background with red and purple items is visible. Yellow and white text overlays the center of the frame. (2) Hands appear on a yellow cutting board, peeling a clove of garlic with a small knife. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A hand adds a spoonful of white salt into a large orange pot of boiling water on a black induction stove. Steam rises significantly from the water. (4) Close-up of hands slicing garlic into thin rounds on the yellow board. The camera remains static and focused on the tactile action. (5) The sliced garlic is placed in a small metal sieve and rinsed under running water from a kitchen tap. (6) A collection of ingredients is displayed: a pile of raw clams on a white plate, a bundle of dried pasta, a bottle of white wine, and a packet of chili flakes. (7) Hands twist a bundle of spaghetti and place it into the boiling water in the orange pot. The camera captures the fanning motion of the noodles. (8) In a different white pot, olive oil is poured and the sliced garlic is added. The garlic sizzles in the oil, and the hand stirs it with a wooden spoon. (9) Clams are added to the pot along with dried chili flakes. White wine is poured from a small bowl over the clams before a red lid is placed on the pot. (10) The lid is removed to reveal open clams in a bubbling sauce. The clams are removed with a slotted spoon and placed on a tray. (11) Cooked spaghetti is transferred from the orange pot into the white pot containing the clam sauce using a sieve. (12) The person, wearing white lace oven mitts, tosses the pot repeatedly to emulsify the sauce. The noodles are vigorously stirred with chopsticks. (13) Clams and broccoli are added back into the pot. Pepper is ground over the dish, and it is plated. (14) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt, is shown eating the pasta with a fork in a bright indoor setting. She smiles, chews, and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 超級簡單又好吃的『白酒蛤蜊義大利麵』就完成啦～～❤️❤️. (2) [Slogan]: 喜歡料豐富的人還可以加入其他海鮮料. (3) [Subtitle]: 準備一鍋水加入適量的鹽. (4) [Subtitle]: 2~3大瓣蒜頭去皮.... (5) [Subtitle]: 用刀尖輕鬆就去好了！. (6) [Subtitle]: 接著再切成蒜片. (7) [Subtitle]: 最後一片躺著切. (8) [Subtitle]: 把切好的蒜片先用水沖洗一下. (9) [Subtitle]: 洗過後就不會煸到燒焦囉～. (10) [Subtitle]: 先晾乾、再擦乾水分. (11) [Subtitle]: 這次兩人份大約是400克蛤蜊. (12) [Subtitle]: 200克義大利麵條. (13) [Subtitle]: 白葡萄酒或任何喜歡的酒乾辣椒，隨意.... (14) [Subtitle]: 水滾囉～. (15) [Subtitle]: 麵條用手轉一下.... (16) [Subtitle]: 像下慢慢壓.... (17) [Subtitle]: 放手～❤️. (18) [Subtitle]: 這時候先煮滾滾了計時2分鐘. (19) [Subtitle]: 煮的時候要不時的攪拌避免黏底. (20) [Subtitle]: 好囉～時間到關火悶10分鐘！. (21) [Subtitle]: 另外一邊起鍋加入適量的橄欖油.... (22) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱隨後放入蒜片.... (23) [Subtitle]: 用中小火慢慢的煸蒜片. (24) [Subtitle]: 大概煸到蒜片開始有點上色. (25) [Subtitle]: 撒入一點乾辣椒片...接著放入蛤蜊. (26) [Subtitle]: 拌炒一下放入白酒60ml. (27) [Subtitle]: 轉中小火....蓋上鍋蓋大約煮兩分鐘，讓蛤蜊開口. (28) [Subtitle]: 好囉～開蓋！. (29) [Subtitle]: 大致上都開口囉！. (30) [Subtitle]: 先把開口的取出來備用還沒開口的，繼續煮到開.... (31) [Subtitle]: 這邊麵也悶10分鐘了！. (32) [Subtitle]: 像這樣煮義大利麵很省瓦斯！. (33) [Subtitle]: 撈起來不用刻意瀝乾直接放入鍋子裡～. (34) [Subtitle]: 快速攪拌一下讓味道融合. (35) [Subtitle]: 接著補兩湯勺煮麵水進來. (36) [Subtitle]: 繼續不停的攪拌加速乳化.... (37) [Subtitle]: 最後再補上橄欖油. (38) [Subtitle]: 可以用筷子快速攪拌.... (39) [Subtitle]: 或者像這樣舉起鍋子甩....讓醬汁產生乳化❤️❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 確認一下狀況....底下的湯像這樣不透明的樣子就是乳化成功囉！. (41) [Subtitle]: 最後再把蛤蜊放回來. (42) [Subtitle]: 放一些煮熟的花椰菜增加膳食纖維！❤️❤️. (43) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌勻...一點綜合胡椒調味.. (44) [Subtitle]: 完成❤️❤️. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a clean female vocal singing in English. The tonality is upbeat and major-mode. (2) A soft metallic clink occurs as a spoon hits a pot, followed by the muffled white-noise sound of water beginning to bubble. The BGM maintains its presence. (3) Rhythmic tapping SFX (short spectral bandwidth transients) represent the sound of a knife on a cutting board, synchronized with the visual of slicing garlic. (4) A gentle sizzling sound (high-frequency broadband noise) enters the mix as garlic is sautéed. The BGM remains the primary layer with a steady 4/4 drum beat. (5) A distinct hollow impact sound occurs as a lid is placed on a pot. The acoustic texture is clear and well-balanced. (6) A pouring liquid SFX with short duration is heard. The vocal melody continues in the background. (7) High-intensity thudding and shuffling sounds are heard as the pot is shaken on the stove. These sounds are slightly louder than the previous SFX but do not mask the music. (8) The video concludes with the sound of a metal fork hitting a ceramic bowl, followed by soft chewing sounds. The music fades out smoothly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Preparation -> Cooking Steps -> Emulsification -> Plating -> Tasting
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an instructional cooking guide for a White Wine Clam Pasta recipe. It uses high-density text overlays to compensate for the lack of spoken narration, guiding the viewer through ingredient prep, cooking times, and technical maneuvers like sauce emulsification. The upbeat BGM and the final tasting segment aim to project a pleasant, accessible lifestyle and encourage viewers to try the recipe themselves.
